title: Neural-Network Renormalized Hamiltonians for VMCRG
lede: Paper baselines are reproduced; the 2D Easy Goal is protocol-incomplete, MPS/TT is supporting evidence, and the 3D Hard Goal remains Stage 6 no-go.

blocks.text: The method combines VMCRG, symmetry-preserving neural local energies, MPS/TT bias representations, immutable checkpoints, independent frozen validation, and staged parallel tempering. Paper reproduction is a method baseline and is not Issue #28 completion.
